thesis: Elementary proofs delimit sufficiency, refinement, distance, decision regret and statistical confidence under explicit assumptions.
role: Provide inspectable guarantees without claims of novelty.

ideas.statement: Elementary proofs delimit sufficiency, refinement, distance, decision regret and statistical confidence under explicit assumptions.
ideas.recurrenceCandidate: Provide inspectable guarantees without claims of novelty.

evidenceAndExamples.statement: Zero failures in 100 independent tests of a fixed candidate yield an approximately 2.95% one-sided 95% upper bound, not proof of zero error.

objectionsAndQualifications.statement: Optimal cost-free refinement does not guarantee an actual learner improves; finite partition refinement need not generalize and adaptive selection changes confidence analysis.

audit.notes: Source-grounded analysis; proposed mechanisms and limited guarantees preserved.
